t: Debugging Asynchronous HTMX: An AI-Assisted Diagnosis
s: This article details an AI-assisted debugging session for an asynchronous HTMX scrolling issue in a notebook-like web interface. The root cause was identified as a divergence in HTMX event patterns between simple and complex workflows, coupled with a missing client-side event listener for the server-sent scroll trigger.
sub: Client-side event listening for DOM updates
